title: Parse URL query parameters
summary: A client-side router converts URL query parameters into a lookup object. Preserve repeated keys according to the exercise’s output contract and handle encoded values correctly. Turn a URL query string into an object while preserving repeated keys.
requirements: Accept a query string with or without an initial ?; input contains no URL fragment (#).
Split nonempty &-separated fields on the first = character only; fields with no = have an empty value.
Decode percent-encoded bytes and treat + as a space in both keys and values.
Represent each key as an array of all its values, even if it appears once; preserve occurrence order.
Ignore empty fields caused by consecutive or trailing & characters.
Malformed percent escapes must throw an Error containing "Invalid encoding".
hints: Remove an optional leading ? and split on &.
Find the first = per pair; other = characters belong to the value.
Use decodeURIComponent after replacing + with spaces; append to each key’s array.
